negative_reviews.author: Eduardo Mtz
negative_reviews.text: Black garlic tonkotsu is great. But staff were underwhelming today. I understand they were busy, but I would have prefer they communicated more effectively instead of simply ignoring and avoiding eye contact with the people queuing. This was done by at least 5 members of staff, not only by the person hosting.

gaps: Stock-take — no variance entered this week

issues: Soho took close to £43K (£42.8K), beating target by £892, but wages were 27.7% because of BOH cost creep and staff deployed from Nori (London KPI meeting 10/11 and Admin Meeting 09/11).
35 hours were cut from the kitchen rota, chef numbers and breaks must be tightly controlled, and closing managers must delete any unapproved hours (London KPI meeting 10/11).
Monday was very quiet, with three morning staff in before the first order at 12:30pm, and the first two weeks of November are historically slow in Soho (London KPI meeting 10/11).
Google rating was 4.87 and spend per head £22 (London KPI meeting 10/11).

Google reviews: twenty six 5 star, one 4 star, two 3 star, two 2 star and one 1 star; the low ratings were about food quality and lack of service, management replied with an invitation back, and both teams went through the service steps and food consistency again.
FOH must ask every table for a review and stick to sections; BOH must taste the broth, check quality and speed, and tell FOH managers about stock levels in advance.
Labour on quieter shifts, especially before closing, is the main area to improve, along with delivery accuracy and wait time, menu knowledge and edamame upselling.
The cleaners did not come as scheduled, and pest control visited on 03/11.
Hygiene checks were 100% for the bar weekly checklist, bathroom checks and BOH, and waste was recorded on the FOH bar.
Delivery packaging has improved, and a new hire is gaining confidence.
Last month Soho cut labour and food cost by 7% each but its tripled rent hit net profit, on top of £67,000 of drainage repairs (London KPI meeting 10/11).
Samples from the new tofu supplier have not yet arrived for Soho (Admin Meeting 09/11).
actions: Control chef numbers and breaks, and delete unapproved staff hours at close - Owner: Imre Balogh (17/11/2026)
Review BOH productivity and staffing shortages - Owner: Remy Eutrope (17/11/2026)
Keep training FOH and BOH on the service and food standards - Owner: Imre Balogh (17/11/2026)
